Title: Arkhiv Iugo-Zapadnoi Rossii, chast' I, tom II: Materialy dlia istorii pravoslaviia v Zapadnoi Ukraine v XVIII st. Arkhimandrit Melkhisedek Znachko-Iavorskii (1759-1771)
Creator: The Kyiv Archaeographic Commission (the series); the documents are the Orthodox clergy's own letters and reports
Publisher: Kyiv, 1864 (title page; the censor's permission at about OCR line 100 is dated Kyiv, 1 April 1864)
Publication Date: 1864 (title page, read directly)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1864); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: rus (pre-reform orthography)
Source: archive.org item aruzr-1-2, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-10 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (1,989,606) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1864, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: fair. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: Documents on Orthodoxy in Right-Bank Ukraine, 1759-1771, around the archimandrite Melkhisedek Znachko-Iavorskii: e.g. a Uniate surrogate's letter to Gervasii, bishop of Pereiaslav and Boryspil, at about OCR line 10629, and Gervasii's report to the Synod at about 7507.
